role: WebSocket gateway that registers supervisor clients with the broadcast service for verdict distribution.
detail: Thin NestJS WebSocket gateway exposing /ws/supervisor endpoint. Implements OnGatewayConnection and OnGatewayDisconnect lifecycle hooks. Single class SupervisorGateway delegates all state management to SupervisorBroadcastService: addClient() on connection, removeClient() on disconnect. Logs connection events via NestJS Logger. Mirrors TelemetryGateway pattern to keep services decoupled from gateway layer; broadcasting logic lives in service, not gateway.
gotchas: Dead code risk: WebSocket client parameter type-checked but no message handlers or heartbeat defined; consider if connection lifecycle alone is sufficient or if disconnect detection should be explicit
